mstts:express-as.prosody: Ever find yourself longing for a bit of quiet in the middle of all that digital noise? If you’ve ever felt like your attention is slipping away with every ping and notification, you’re definitely not alone. Imagine what it would be like to live with more focus, more intention—and less digital overwhelm. That’s the journey Cal Newport invites us to take in his book, Digital Minimalism: Choosing a Focused Life in a Noisy World. Together, we’re going to explore what happens when we stop letting technology dictate our days and instead become intentional about how we use it. What if, by cutting out the unnecessary digital clutter, we could build deeper connections, get more done, and actually feel a sense of calm again? Newport’s ideas challenge the notion that every new app or platform deserves our attention. Instead, he offers a refreshing approach: choose your digital tools with care, based on your values—not just habit. Along the way, you’ll pick up practical strategies and some eye-opening perspectives on how to let technology serve you, not the other way around. We’ll talk about rediscovering solitude, meaningful work, and true relationships—even in this hyper-connected world. So, as we take this journey together, get ready to trade noise for clarity, and distraction for real intention. Let’s find out what it really means to live a focused, fulfilling life—one mindful step at a time.
